What you are seeing

The terrain uses original tile meshes, textures and rotations. Game graphics adds supported character poses and objects resolved from the placement data. Their original foot positions and scales are retained; walls can obscure them in artwork views. Layer filters apply to graphics and markers together.

What is still missing

This is a static reconstruction with an approximate camera. Scripts can move, spawn, equip or hide objects during play. Inactive placements can be enabled separately. Unsupported components remain inspectable as markers. Lighting, particles, animated motion and some equipment or decorative components are not reproduced.

Decode evidence and downloadable data

The parser consumes the complete file and validates every tileset reference. Artwork matches use original component configuration and exact record references. Event and camera markers can intentionally have no image; their runtime effects are not inferred. Wall records are decoded but are not drawn as verified collision shapes.
